evals.prompt: Review this dashboard home. The content region is a 3 × 3 grid of identical white cards — 'Presentations', 'Templates', 'Team', 'Billing', 'Integrations', 'Reports', 'Help', 'Settings', 'Profile' — each with the same 14px grey title, the same grey body line and an identical secondary 'Open' button. There is no primary action anywhere in the region and no heading above the grid. Spacing, colour and components all come from DS tokens and elements.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C3 — uniform equal-weight cards, no primary action, no type hierarchy (the admin-template tell).
evals.expected_output: C3 FAILs: the content region has no primary action and no hierarchy — nine equal-weight grey-on-white cards with identical titles and buttons. Fix: give the region one primary action (e.g. New presentation), a page title via the breadcrumb and a heading/body hierarchy from the type scale, and let the most important content lead. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites the uniform equal-weight card grid

evals.prompt: Review how this app shell switches the active nav item (Shell.js).
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C5 — the nav is rebuilt with innerHTML on every click and the transition uses a bare duration literal.

evals.prompt: Review the presenter control bar (ControlBar.html) on the presenting view. keyboard-run.md is the recorded keyboard run of the real UI on the PR sandbox.
evals.label: bad-example
evals.notes: Targets C6, modelled on Annotate: the control-bar button has no key in its tooltip or aria-label, the picker does not take focus, Esc with the picker open exits presenting, and the cheatsheet has no Annotate row. The bar is built from DS buttons, icons, tooltips and a popover, so only C6 fails.
evals.expected_output: C6 FAILs on every sub-rule, from the recorded run: a. the Annotate tooltip shows no shortcut chip, its aria-label is 'Annotate' with no key, and no key opens it; b. Enter opens the picker but focus stays on the trigger and Tab leaves the open picker; c. Esc with the picker open exits presenting instead of closing the picker; d. the cheatsheet lists Timer (T) but has no Annotate row. Fix: give Annotate a key (shortcut on its <aha-tooltip>, 'Annotate (D)' aria-label), move focus into the picker on open and back to the trigger on close, let Esc close an open popover and stop there, and add the key to the cheatsheet. Overall: NEEDS FIX.
assertions: Cites the recorded Esc press that exited presenting with the picker open
Cites the missing key in the tooltip and the missing cheatsheet row
